'''Feldon''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] agent of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3641 BBY]], he was among those Imperials spreading the riot on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Feldon recruited the leader of the [[Condemned]] [[Nyranos]] to urge the prisoners to rise against the Republic. However, Nyranos had his own motives and was not averse to peaceful solution. When he voiced his desire to negotiate in Feldon's presence, he lost his use, and Feldon tried to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him. Instead, Nyranos defeated him with the help of a Republic individual.
